metadata.question: Did Arrachart in Madagascar recieve more than 22 inches of rainfall during the month of January 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY), filter for a 10 km buffer around Arrachart Airport, Madagascar, from 2020-01-01 to 2020-02-01 (Jan 2020). If collection is empty, return C1.
2. Masking strategy: CHIRPS provides precipitation in mm/day; mask is inherent. Sum daily to monthly and compute mean over the buffer. No cloud masking is needed for precipitation products.
3. Logic: Check image count; then compute valid pixel count from the monthly sum. If valid pixel count is 0 => C2. If result is null/NaN or out-of-range => C3. Otherwise compare inches > 22 to decide A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const point = ee.Geometry.Point([49.291, -12.349]); // Arrachart Airport vicinity
    const region = point.buffer(10000); // 10 km buffer
    const start = '2020-01-01';
    const end = '2020-02-01';
    const thresholdInches = 22.0;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(region)
      .select('precipitation');
    const nImgs = await col.size().getInfo();
    console.log(`Location: Arrachart, Madagascar (10 km buffer)`);
    console.log(`Date Range: 2020-01-01 to 2020-01-31`);
    console.log(`CHIRPS Daily Images: ${nImgs}`);
    if (!nImgs || nImgs === 0) {
      console.log(`No images found for the specified date/location.`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const monthlySum = col.sum(); // mm over the month
    // Count valid pixels in the buffer
    const countDict = await monthlySum.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 5500,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();
    const validPix = countDict ? countDict['precipitation'] : 0;
    console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${validPix}`);
    if (!validPix || validPix === 0) {
      console.log(`No valid pixels after processing.`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const meanDict = await monthlySum.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 5500,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();
    const mm = meanDict ? meanDict['precipitation'] : null;
    if (mm === null || Number.isNaN(mm) || !Number.isFinite(mm) || mm < 0 || mm > 5000) {
      console.log(`Calculation invalid (mm: ${mm}).`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const inches = mm / 25.4;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Monthly Rainfall (mm): ${mm.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Monthly Rainfall (in): ${inches.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Threshold (in): ${thresholdInches}`);

    if (inches > thresholdInches) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
